name: GS1-Conformant Resolver Standard 1.2.1
status: Release 1.2.1 ratified August 2026 (standards page and PDF print no day); the archive page on ref.gs1.org lists "Published 19 August 2026".
relevance: The standard defines how a GS1 Digital Link URI, which carries a product or location key such as a GTIN or a Global Location Number (GLN), is resolved to related information sources. The query string "carries attributes of the identified entity and does not form part of the entity's identifier"; for an invalid request URI "the resolver SHALL respond with an HTTP response code of 400 (Bad Request)", and for a valid URI with no information it "SHALL return a simple 404 Not Found response" (sections 2.12, 2.4.1). A conformant resolver publishes a Resolver Description File at /.well-known/gs1resolver.
boundary: Out of scope: identical targets or linksets across resolvers, and any particular behaviour for query string parameters.

evidence.read: Standards page, PDF (text extracted) and archive page of the Resolver, in full, 2026-10-03; for dates also the URI Syntax standard page and archive.
